limitation: PitchBook connector provides quarterly TTM income statement/balance sheet and EV history but no cash-flow statements or consensus estimates; Yahoo statements cover ~4 fiscal years; SEC EDGAR not used (requires a real contact e-mail). Forward multiples are therefore not shown; forward views rely on company guidance (labelled TARGET).

Several company IR sites blocked automated access (HTTP 403: e.g. sgs.com, compass-group.com, straumann.com, unilever.com); agents did not bypass and used RNS mirrors, filings, transcripts and reputable secondary sources, flagged in source notes.

Agents' web-search quota was exhausted late in research; some later items came from direct IR fetches or PitchBook transcripts. Some historical figures are marked 'recall' (confidence L/M) and are listed in QC_Report.md.

Five-year cash-flow history is incomplete: Yahoo gives ~4 annual years + TTM; 3-year FCF conversion uses those years. 10-year revenue/EBITDA/net-debt/EV histories come from PitchBook (current vintage, may embed restatements).

Historical EV/EBITDA is point-in-time with reporting lags (US/CA 50/75 days, Europe 65/80 days) but uses PitchBook current-vintage fundamentals and PitchBook-implied economic share counts; not as-first-reported. Excluded where implied shares deviate >10% from reported (e.g. Compass).

IFRS 16 vs ASC 842 aligned via post-lease EBITDAaL and EV ex-leases; IFRS lease payments from annual reports (FY figures applied to LTM). US finance-lease principal assumed immaterial. Linen/uniform rental depreciation (Elis) makes EV/EBITDA understate cost - use FCF/EV-EBIT.
Provider 'unusual items' are added back only when non-recurring; company-adjusted EBITDA (e.g. broker EBITDAC) is not used for valuation.

FTSE All-Share TR and FTSE 250 TR index levels unavailable; ETF proxies used (FTSE 100 Acc ETF; Vanguard FTSE 250 ETF with distributions reinvested; fees 0.07-0.10%). Sector ETFs for insurance include carriers (imperfect for brokers). Withholding taxes ignored (gross dividends).

Exercise B (valid point-in-time strategy backtest) not possible: no historical eligible universe incl. delistings, no dated qualitative evidence, no as-first-reported data. A survivorship-biased quantitative diagnostic is shown, clearly labelled.

Investor's weights, cash, cost bases, wrappers, borrowing and margin terms are unknown; whole-portfolio risk and leverage effects cannot be quantified. Existing holdings proxied (Accor, TUI, Jet2 prices; MSCI World and FTSE 100 ETFs for index funds).
Broker commissions, FX fees and CGT status not verified; illustrative assumptions only (UK stamp duty 0.5% on UK-incorporated shares; FX ~0.25-0.5%; spreads 0.05-0.3%).

Spin-offs handled through Yahoo back-adjustment (value reinvested in parent). Compass quote currency: Yahoo switches 2-Jan-2026, company says 1-Apr-2026; Jan-Mar 2026 Compass series is a provider conversion (possible ~+7.6% artefact on 1-Apr-2026).
Revenue geography disclosures are heterogeneous; US share used as a lower-bound proxy for North America where only US is disclosed; coverage incomplete (shown in Exposures_Stress).
Monitoring code tested once interactively (2026-11-12) to establish a baseline; no schedule activated. First run lists all current items as new by design.
